caption_L1: This is a bar diagram titled Average price of wool paid to producers in Canada in 2018 , by region (in Canadian dollars per kilogram). province of Canada is measured along a categorical scale starting at Alberta and ending at Saskatchewan on the y-axis. caption_L2L3: Ten regions of Canada produce wool. The average price of wool paid to producers in each region varies, with producers in Quebec receiving the least, at a little over 0.5 Canadian dollars per kilogram, and producers in Alberta receiving the most, at almost 2 Canadian dollars per kilogram. Producers in the other regions receive a fairly consistent price of around 1 Canadian dollar per kilogram.
